name: Organon lifecycle-aware semantic recall v2
description: Forty-five paraphrased questions frozen before local inference. Labels are current, lifecycle-active Organon units drawn from real dogfooding decisions, failures, and cited prior art.

cases.query: How do we stop an outside theorist's polished answer from quietly becoming project authority?
Why should stale failures from old evidence stop making today's research frontier look broken?
How can changing one experimental value force the surrounding prose verdict to be checked again?
What is the friendly human doorway for asking this research memory what it knows?
Can ordinary note links provide neighborhoods without running a graph database?
Which retrieval key is transparent and carries confidence labels?
How are missing relationships suggested without machine learning?
Why should Claude and Codex share mechanics instead of maintaining separate implementations?
How can the lab notebook accept unusual labels while curated claims reject them?
What prevents two agents appending at once from losing an event or minting the same identifier?
Why must ledger headings inside fenced examples be parsed by the same routine everywhere?
What contract prevents links accepted by the writer from disappearing after a rebuild?
Why should a resolved typed relation stop a note being called isolated?
Which real project proved that retired hashes can be warnings while every live dependency remains green?
relevant: Validate Promptus v0.9.1 against the current MoT v5 store

cases.query: What read-only guard refuses to resume when the handoff or retrieval receipt is stale?
relevant: Validate the v0.8.2 fail-closed bookkeeping candidate

cases.query: Why is the mutable resume header written by its own bounded gate rather than appended as an event?
relevant: kb-now is a separate gated script, not a kb-add mode

cases.query: How can we ask whether a long research route is narrowing without assigning it a progress score?
Why may a retrospective select evidence but never reopen work or change scientific authority automatically?
What did the first semantic trial reveal about paraphrase recall and stale-note contamination?
Why did symmetric rank fusion bury the one answer found only by meaning?
May unpublished Psi or MoT notes be sent through either free OpenRouter embedding route?
Which open checkpoint was selected for the strongest private local retrieval comparison?
If semantic vectors help, why do they remain disposable rather than replacing the notes?
What measured failure would justify adding SQLite without making it the source of truth?
How can an old project move into the namespaced layout without rewriting its knowledge units?
How does the paper tool stay general while encoding a conference's particular submission contract?
Why are column widths learned from probe compilations instead of copied from prose documentation?
What figure discipline makes a panel readable at its final journal slot rather than only on a large canvas?
How should a load-bearing result appear in prose, tables, and captions without being copied by hand?
What makes claim confidence a property recorded at write time rather than a guess during retrieval?
Why are real project workarounds treated as the unwritten specification for Organon?
What development loop turns a concrete Psi or Probatio failure into a reusable same-day repair?
Why do Promptus and Editio get separate version tags even though they share one repository?
relevant: Per-plugin release tags: promptus-v* and editio-v* from the one organon monorepo

cases.query: Why can reinstalling an unchanged plugin version leave Codex looking at an older tree?
relevant: editio cache froze pre-spine - the version string is the install cache key; 0.1.0 covered two trees

cases.query: What can go wrong if a merged base branch is deleted before dependent pull requests are retargeted?
relevant: delete-branch cascade-closes stacked PRs; safe merge protocol for release chains

cases.query: What is the safe sequence for adopting Promptus in a repository with existing research records?
Which existing open knowledge format is closest to the storage substrate, and what discipline remains ours?
Which prior memory system models facts and episodes on a time-aware graph?
What nearest-neighbour idea helps suppress hubs when suggesting latent links?
What 2026 evidence says exact lexical lookup can beat dense retrieval for agent code and precise corpora?
Which theoretical result says one vector cannot perfectly answer every multi-fact retrieval query?
Which local-first Markdown tool already derives a SQLite index and exposes it through MCP?
Which compact entailment checker can audit whether generated claims are grounded in supplied evidence?
Which official conference package fixes the class file and paper-mode contract for the 2026 main track?
Which venue requires a mandatory checklist after the references and before supplementary material?
